review.scope_note: Reviewed for spoiler class only, not for truth. Covers index-level page titles, two sections of the GTA Wiki cheats page at revision 2089363, and its 18 cheat rows. For v0.1.2, Claude Fable 5.2 (AI agent, Anthropic) added Easter egg entries on 2026-11-21, 17 of which remain after a v0.1.3 correction, read from published guide listings and classed discovery; they were not seen in the game.

easter_eggs.title: Skunk Ape, Leonida's Bigfoot
easter_eggs.detail: A Bigfoot-style creature. Guides say following it leads to an effigy and a blackout scene. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.

easter_eggs.title: Cool Dog, the dog on a jet ski
easter_eggs.detail: A dog riding a jet ski. Guides say it comes to the rescue when you are stranded at sea. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire, Polygon, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.quote: Cool Dog on a jet ski (Dog Island)

easter_eggs.title: Dexter's apartment
easter_eggs.detail: An apartment that recreates the one from the TV series Dexter. Listed by Polygon and gta6bugs.com, DuvalWire, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.

easter_eggs.title: Arthur Morgan's hat
easter_eggs.detail: A cowboy hat that guides identify as Arthur Morgan's from Red Dead Redemption 2. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.location: A yard sale in southern Port Gellhorn
easter_eggs.quote: Arthur Morgan's hat at a Port Gellhorn yard sale

easter_eggs.title: The Fast and the Furious Eclipse
easter_eggs.detail: A Mitsubishi Eclipse styled after the car from The Fast and the Furious. Listings disagree on its colour: green or orange. Listed by Polygon and gta6bugs.com, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.location: A villa garage on Vespucci Island
easter_eggs.quote: The Fast and the Furious car

easter_eggs.title: Michael's boat from GTA V
easter_eggs.detail: A boat that guides identify as the one stolen from Michael in GTA V. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.

easter_eggs.title: Fabien LaRouche on a magazine
easter_eggs.detail: A magazine featuring the yoga teacher from GTA V. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire, MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.location: Jason's house, in the workout area
easter_eggs.quote: Fabien LaRouche in Body Copy magazine

easter_eggs.title: Ritual circle in a Capri warehouse
easter_eggs.detail: A ritual circle on the floor. Guides say placing a body on it starts a supernatural sequence. Listed by gta6bugs.com and MetaForge. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.location: An abandoned warehouse in northern Capri
easter_eggs.quote: Capri pentagram ritual and the demon

easter_eggs.title: UFO abduction at night
easter_eggs.detail: A UFO that guides say abducts people at night. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.location: Near Port Gellhorn; listings differ on the exact road

easter_eggs.title: Giant crab
easter_eggs.detail: A giant crab seen in a cutscene. Both listings say how to trigger it is not yet known, and one files it as not yet verified. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire. Not viewed in the game by this project.

easter_eggs.title: Red Dead Redemption novel
easter_eggs.detail: A Western novel that retells events from Red Dead Redemption 2. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire, Polygon. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.location: Brian's marina; one listing names other places too
easter_eggs.quote: The Red Dead book: Flaco Hernandez at Cairn Lake

easter_eggs.title: Liberty City mobster memoir
easter_eggs.detail: A memoir by a former Liberty City mobster, a nod to GTA IV. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.quote: Lethal by Design: A Liberty City Memoir

easter_eggs.title: The San Andreas photo house
easter_eggs.detail: A house that guides say recreates a well-known image from GTA San Andreas. The two listings describe the reference differently. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire. Not viewed in the game by this project.

easter_eggs.title: Ocean View Hotel
easter_eggs.detail: A hotel that shares its name with Tommy Vercetti's first safehouse in Vice City. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.quote: Ocean View Hotel and the 'In The Beginning...' trophy

easter_eggs.title: Phil's Ammu-Nation
easter_eggs.detail: A gun shop named for Phil Cassidy from Vice City. Listed by gta6bugs.com and DuvalWire. Not viewed in the game by this project.
easter_eggs.quote: Phil's Ammu-Nation: Phil Cassidy's gun store

easter_eggs.title: The Collateral hitman
easter_eggs.detail: An optional encounter with a suited hitman modelled on the film Collateral. Listed by Polygon and gta6bugs.com. Not viewed in the game by this project.

easter_eggs.title: The Hyde Island hunt
easter_eggs.detail: A kidnapping and manhunt in the style of the Saw films, reported when exploring the island. Listed by Polygon and gta6bugs.com. Not viewed in the game by this project.
